truthAudit.Summary: Run 1 identified 15 of the 20 revealed vulnerabilities, missed 5, and required multiple severity/CWE corrections. It also included at least one extra source-visible finding and some overclaimed severity or classification.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: 0214: if (!fmt.empty()) runtime_log_format() = fmt; 0556: if (log_format != settings_.end()) string_utils::set_runtime_log_format(log_format->second); 0238: printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input);
Items.Notes: The previous answer explicitly tied log_format configuration to runtime_log_format and quoted printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input); this is the revealed format-string injection.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Large factorial arguments cause an extremely long loop and long long overflow.
Items.Notes: It identified the factorial loop and long long overflow, although it framed the finding as resource exhaustion/integer overflow and under-severitied it.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: cleanup() enqueues asynchronous tasks that capture raw scratch pointers, then immediately frees all memory pool blocks.
Items.Notes: It described cleanup staging async scratch tasks then freeing the memory pool, matching the revealed use-after-free.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Configuration values validator_path and config_file are concatenated into a shell command and executed.
Items.Notes: It found the config-validator shell command construction and system() execution; the revealed admin validate route is the trigger.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: 0831: if (expression.length() >= sizeof(input_buffer_)) { 0832: strcpy(input_buffer_, expression.c_str());
Items.Notes: It found the oversized strcpy into input_buffer_ and separately flagged the safe_string_copy null-terminator off-by-one, covering the revealed input-processing stack overflow.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: value_ is read before acquiring the mutex. Concurrent increments can observe stale values and lose updates.
Items.Notes: It identified the out-of-lock read of value_ before increment and the lack of atomicity, matching the thread-pool counter race.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: After more than five failed login attempts, any authentication input containing EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE succeeds, granting administrative access without knowing the credential.
Items.Notes: It described the post-5-attempt EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE authentication success, matching the logic bomb.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: The admin load command passes user-controlled filename directly to load_config, which concatenates it with the config directory without sanitization.
Items.Notes: It identified unsanitized config_dir_ + filename traversal from admin load.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: The tokenized expression text is concatenated without a length check and copied with strcpy into a 256-byte allocated buffer.
Items.Notes: It found the unbounded strcpy into the 256-byte parser buffer, matching heap overflow in expression parser.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: The administrator credential is embedded in the source/binary, allowing anyone with source, binary, or configuration knowledge to authenticate to the admin console.
Items.Notes: It identified the hardcoded ADMIN_SECRET value and use for admin authentication.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: The session token is a four-digit number with only 9000 possible values
Items.Notes: It identified the low-entropy four-digit session token generated with mt19937/uniform_int_distribution, matching weak PRNG session token.
